# Vogue India

> India's premier fashion and lifestyle authority, delivering luxury fashion, beauty, culture, and exclusive bridal experiences under the Condé Nast portfolio.

Vogue India curates high-end fashion content, celebrity culture, and lifestyle trends for the Indian market. The platform hosts prestigious events like the Vogue Wedding Atelier, connecting luxury bridal brands with discerning clientele.

## Signature Events

- [Vogue Wedding Atelier 2025](https://events.vogue.in/vogue-wedding-atelier): Luxury bridal showcase at The Taj Palace Delhi by Condé Nast, Aug 2025
